notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Live Proof
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video successfully demonstrates collaborative spreadsheet editing and multi-agent execution (public and private) within the NodeRoom war room. However, it suffers from an 8-second blank white screen at the start which needs to be trimmed.

featureClarity.evidence: Clearly shows human users and AI agents interacting with a financial spreadsheet and chat interface.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Demonstrates the complete flow from room entry to chat-triggered agent execution and final cell updates.

visualDesign.evidence: High-density dark UI with clear active states, though the layout is somewhat busy with multiple panels.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the product story of collaborative files, spreadsheets, and integrated AI agents.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic browser capture showing real-time state changes, trace logs, and agent execution steps.

legibility.evidence: Most UI elements are readable, though chat text and spreadsheet formulas are quite small.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant for financial analysts and diligence teams managing complex workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Shows realistic agent latency and step-by-step execution without deceptive edits.

observedEvidence: Public and private AI agent execution and chat feedback
Active event trace logging at the bottom of the workspace
missingEvidence: Explicit demonstration of no-clobber behavior during simultaneous human-agent edits.

defects.observed: The video starts with an empty white screen lasting approximately 8 seconds before the UI loads.
defects.fix: Trim the video to start at 0:09 when the login screen appears.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeRoom's public and private AI agents collaborate with team members to analyze financial variance and update diligence spreadsheets in real-time.
